# AEO Command

> Multi-tenant Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) platform for marketing agencies.
> Publisher: Threezero Agency (https://threezero.agency)

AEO Command helps agencies scan client websites, produce a prioritized Action Center of fixes, track AI visibility prompts over time, and deliver white-label reports. It is built for multi-client teams — not one-off free score checks.

## Product facts

- Website AEO scan (crawl + analysis; Firecrawl/Claude optional)
- Action Center with assignable tasks and suggested fixes
- Visibility prompt tracking and history
- White-label live report links
- Team invites and strict agencyId tenant isolation
- Pakistan and International pricing tiers
- 14-day free trial via /signup
